## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `ci` / `chore` / `refactor` / `test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, …)
- [ ] Linked issue (`Fixes #NN` or `Relates to #NN`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and green (see CONTRIBUTING.md for per-repo commands)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README`, `docs/`, Swagger/ADR as applicable)
- [ ] No secrets in diff (`.env`, keys, `*_SECRET` redacted)
- [ ] Screenshots for web UI changes

## Contract changes (if any)

- [ ] No contract interface change, **or**
- [ ] ADR added in `stellarrail-contracts/docs/adr/` and interface-freeze
      review requested
